cannotStart: A new exploration could not start
whatItIs: An exploration is a board you work on with the kobold: what the problem really is, a few ways to solve it, and a prototype for each. The one you agree on goes to the factory.
nothingExplored: Nothing is being explored. Start one that waits.

handOffMissing.prototype: Agree on the prototype first, with its variant: the factory builds from it. Or ask Doodle to take it off the board if you do not want it built.
handOffMissing.variant: The prototype is agreed, but not which variant to build: choose one.
handOffMissing.something: Nothing is agreed yet: agree on a choice or a note on the board first.

handOffNotOnBoard: Issue #{{number}} was made, but it is not on the board after waiting for GitHub to add it. Add it to the board by hand, or hand off again: it carries on with that issue.

handOffStages.card: Making the card on the board

talk.role: Thinks it through with you and draws on the board

reading.title: {{name}} is reading
reading.hint: It draws once it understands your idea

stopped.signedOut: Claude Code is not signed in
stopped.signedOutHow: Run claude once in a terminal to sign in, then try again
stopped.missing: Claude Code is not on this computer
stopped.missingHow: Install it from claude.com/code and sign in, then try again
stopped.noReason: The explorer stopped: no reason given

fromBacklog: an idea from the board's Backlog

board.label: The exploration's board
board.agreedHint: Agreed: click to make it a sketch
board.problemHere: The kobold writes the problem here.
board.pictureUnreadable: The picture could not be read.
board.onlyPictures: Only pictures can go on the board.
board.showArchived: Show the {{n}} other variants, archived since one was agreed
board.stillMade: Still being made: you can use it, and it changes as the kobold works
board.preparingCopy: Preparing its copy of the code
board.settingUpStart: {{name}} is working out how to start your app
board.tinkerSetUp: {{name}} set up how to start your app, for the whole team.
board.couldNotTitle: {{name}} could not get your app to start.
board.couldNotNoReason: {{name}} tried a few ways to start your app, but none of them came up.
